marketTone: Tuesday was a Hormuz-diplomacy and oil-plunge session that pulled Treasury yields to 4.63% and let chips bounce into Nvidia's Wednesday print. The 财经早茶 chart shows A-share Q3 IPO fundraising surging toward 1100亿元 through 25 August. Canada doubled steel and aluminum tariffs to 50% while Trump threatened to rename Lake Ontario. Jack Ma and Cai Chongxin kept buying Alibaba after the HK$80bn placing. Copper closed at a record and gold extended as inflation worry eased with Brent below $90 intraday.

财经早茶 今日图表: A-share Q3 IPO fundraising has surged on the Bloomberg bar chart through 25 August (desk — see Chart section). 人民网 Aug 26: fiscal-financial domestic-demand tools were upgraded from 1 August, with more measures promised in H2.
BlockBeats (25 August): Jack Ma bought more than HK$600m of Alibaba; Cai Chongxin bought for a second day.

见闻: London copper hit a record before easing near $14,200/t; spot gold touched $4,696.83 and settled $4,662.05 (+0.21%). 财经早茶 市场一览: copper a record close and gold extended as inflation concern eased. signal: Oil falling on Hormuz diplomacy pulled the 10-year yield to 4.63%, but Wednesday's PCE and Nvidia print still sit in front of Warsh. The 今日图表 is A-share IPO volume, not chip earnings. themeCards.title: Hormuz diplomacy pulled oil and Treasury yields lower together
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 国际要闻: Iran and Oman discussed a temporary joint maritime corridor and demining to restore Hormuz shipping, with a permanent route to be negotiated in 30–60 days. Satellite images showed higher Iraqi Gulf crude loading Monday. AP: Brent fell 3.6% to $87.27 Tuesday; the 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.63% from 4.70% late Monday. 见闻: Brent settled −3.89% at $88.58 after an intraday drop of more than 6% below $90; WTI settled −3.12% at $82.36. 财经早茶 市场一览: oil plunged as diplomacy revived hope the Iran war will not escalate; long-end Treasuries outperformed as traders trimmed Fed hike bets.
themeCards.mechanism: A headline that reopens Hormuz is a supply-relief trade in oil and a duration bid in Treasuries at the same time. AP still had Iran–US tension in the same session, so this is diplomacy pricing, not a confirmed tanker count. Wednesday PCE sits on top of the yield move.
themeCards.trigger: A dated reopening step, or PCE hot enough to reverse the 7 bp yield drop.
themeCards.invalidator: Brent rallying through PCE with no new strait closure headline.

themeCards.title: Nvidia bounced into Wednesday earnings as AI capex scrutiny intensifies
themeCards.fact: AP: Nvidia rose 2.2% Tuesday and ended a seven-day drop; the S&P 500 closed 7,677.28 (+0.3%) and the Nasdaq 26,151.30 (+0.7%). 见闻: the PHLX semiconductor index rose 1.4%; AMD +4.9%. Nvidia reports Wednesday after the US close. 财经早茶 国际要闻: analysts expect revenue growth to stay ahead of peers, but Franklin Templeton's desk wants capital-deployment detail. Morgan Stanley: off-balance AI commitments for five hyperscalers plus Nvidia and Broadcom exceed $3.1tn. BlockBeats (24 August): Street looks for about USD92bn of Q2 revenue; options price a 5.3% one-day move and the past four prints saw next-day drops. OpenAI said its Jalapeno chip beat Nvidia's line in tests (财经早茶).
themeCards.mechanism: Tuesday's chip bounce came with yields down, so read it as positioning into earnings, not proof the AI capex cycle re-accelerated. CICC (11 August): large AI spend still needs real downstream demand and manageable credit — memory inflation has not erased model margins. The $3.1tn off-balance headline is a financing question for Wednesday's call.
themeCards.trigger: Nvidia's Wednesday guidance on capex, buybacks, or China exposure; or a session where SOXX holds the bounce through PCE.
themeCards.invalidator: A beat with a soft capex guide and semis giving back Tuesday's gain.

themeCards.title: Canada doubled steel and aluminum tariffs to 50% as the lake rename fight escalated
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 国际要闻: Canada doubled US steel and aluminum tariffs to 50%, launched support for trade-hit firms, and Trump threatened to rename Lake Ontario "Lake America." 见闻: Canada announced USD20bn of retaliatory tariffs covering about 700 categories plus a CAD7.5bn aid plan. BlockBeats (25 August): Bessent said Trump wants sincere talks after the escalation.
themeCards.mechanism: This is the same North America trade fight as Saturday's list, now with metals at 50% and rhetoric on geography. A 2027 auto tariff start from Monday's thread is still a political calendar trade, not a same-week growth shock.
themeCards.trigger: A dated Canadian response list or Bessent talks with a timeline.
themeCards.invalidator: Tariffs walked back with no new retaliation date.

themeCards.title: A-share Q3 IPO fundraising surged on the 今日图表 through 25 August
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 今日图表: the Bloomberg bar chart titled "A-share IPO fundraising has surged since Q3" shows Q3 2026 fundraising at about 1100亿元 through 25 August, up from roughly 450亿元 in Q2 and 250亿元 in Q1; 2024–2025 quarters mostly stayed below 500亿元. 财经早茶 大中华: MOF plans a more active fiscal stance and the NDRC vice chair said H2 should release domestic demand more forcefully. 人民网 Aug 26: fiscal-financial domestic-demand tools were upgraded from 1 August with more policies due in H2.
themeCards.mechanism: The chart is issuance volume, not CSI 300 beta. CICC (7 August): large hard-tech IPOs lifted monthly totals and the pipeline is still building — a desk view on primary-market liquidity, not a guarantee that secondaries follow.
themeCards.trigger: A dated batch of STAR or ChiNext listings, or an incremental fiscal package with a yuan size.
themeCards.invalidator: IPO pacing slows materially with no fiscal follow-through.

themeCards.title: Jack Ma and Cai Chongxin kept buying Alibaba after the HK$80bn placing
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 大中华: Cai Chongxin bought for a second consecutive day and Jack Ma recently bought more than HK$600m of Alibaba shares, showing support for the AI build-out. BlockBeats (25 August, 科创板日报): Ma's purchases exceeded HK$600m; Cai and Wu Yongming added about HK$200m over two days after the HK$80bn placing for full-stack AI. 见闻: management purchases now total more than HK$800m. 财经早茶 市场一览: the Golden Dragon index rose with NetEase and Kanzhun the largest contributors — not an Alibaba-only tape.
themeCards.mechanism: This is insider support after dilution, not proof of China demand. The placing closed 26 August; buys timed to that window are signal, not earnings. Hang Seng can diverge from Golden Dragon when one name carries the ADR book.
themeCards.trigger: The placing close, or 9988 holding above the placing gap into earnings season.
themeCards.invalidator: Insiders stop buying with the stock back through the placing price.

themeCards.title: Copper hit a record close and gold extended as oil fell and inflation worry eased
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 市场一览: London copper closed at a record as traders watched US currency and trade policy plus tight supply; gold extended as inflation concern eased. 见闻: LME copper hit a record then eased near $14,200/t; spot gold touched $4,696.83 and settled $4,662.05 (+0.21%). AP: lower oil reined in inflation worry and helped pull the 10-year yield to 4.63%.
themeCards.mechanism: Copper is pricing trade, tariff, and mine-supply friction; gold is pricing the oil-led inflation relief that came with Hormuz headlines. They can rise together without sharing one mechanism — watch PCE to see which book keeps the bid.
themeCards.trigger: July PCE at 20:30 Beijing, or a dated US copper-tariff inventory move.
themeCards.invalidator: Gold and copper both fading if PCE runs hot and yields retrace Tuesday's drop.

themeCards.title: US consumer confidence hit a seven-month low ahead of July PCE
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 国际要闻: the Conference Board August consumer confidence index fell to a seven-month low; new-home sales hit a six-month low as mortgage rates stayed high. 见闻: confidence printed 89.4, the weakest since January; expectations also fell to a January low. Boston Fed Collins said she would consider tightening if inflation does not keep improving, and cited AI infrastructure lifting core goods inflation (见闻). Richmond Fed Barkin speaks at 23:45 Beijing tonight.
themeCards.mechanism: Confidence and housing softness are household books; Collins ties AI capex to goods inflation — that is the bridge into tonight's core PCE. Tuesday's yield drop helps risk assets only if PCE does not reopen the hike conversation.
themeCards.trigger: US July core PCE at 20:30 Beijing (consensus 0.2% m/m).
themeCards.invalidator: Core PCE at or below consensus with yields holding the 4.63% print.

globalRegime: Hormuz diplomacy and a sharp oil drop pulled Treasury yields to 4.63% and let US equities bounce into Nvidia's Wednesday print. Canada doubled steel and aluminum tariffs to 50%. A-share Q3 IPO fundraising surged on the 今日图表. Copper closed at a record and gold extended. Consumer confidence hit a seven-month low before PCE.

globalImplies.text: Do not read Tuesday's chip bounce as the AI capex cycle re-proving itself before Nvidia's guide. Oil-led yield relief can fade on one hot PCE print.
